rules.condition: Register REG_k at offset 0x00+4k, k=0..PARA_NUM_REGS-1, is reset
rules.statement: REG_k VALUE (bits 31:0, RW) shall reset to 0x0000_0000, so o_regs[32k+31:32k] is 0 after reset.

rules.condition: For each k from 0 to PARA_NUM_REGS-1
rules.statement: o_regs[32k+31:32k] shall be driven by the current value of REG_k.
Each byte lane of REG_k shall be written only when the corresponding i_s_axi_wstrb bit is set; other byte lanes shall keep their value.
A read of REG_k shall return the current register value with OKAY response.

rules.condition: A read of STATUS at offset 0x40
rules.statement: A read of STATUS shall return i_status sampled at Ear, with OKAY response.

rules.condition: A write to STATUS at offset 0x40
rules.statement: A write to STATUS shall change nothing and answer OKAY.

rules.condition: A read from an address from 4*PARA_NUM_REGS to 0x3C (unmapped)
rules.statement: A read of the unmapped region below STATUS shall return 0 with SLVERR.

rules.condition: A write to an address from 4*PARA_NUM_REGS to 0x3C (unmapped)
rules.statement: A write to the unmapped region below STATUS shall change nothing and answer SLVERR.
The reserved region from 4*PARA_NUM_REGS to 0x3C shall not exist when PARA_NUM_REGS is 16.

rules.condition: A read from an address from 0x44 to 2^PARA_ADDR_W - 4
rules.statement: A read of the unmapped region above STATUS shall return 0 with SLVERR.

rules.condition: A write to an address from 0x44 to 2^PARA_ADDR_W - 4
rules.statement: A write to the unmapped region above STATUS shall change nothing and answer SLVERR.
Address bits [1:0] shall be ignored when decoding register offsets.
The register map shall match the table exactly for every legal PARA_NUM_REGS and PARA_ADDR_W combination.
